name: deere.strategy-quality
description: Task-specific advisory review for the Deere Construction public-research Business Case. Evaluate supplied evidence, not elegance. Code separately enforces all critical probabilities >=0.90 and deterministic artifact checks. No strategy selection, execution approval or calibrated business-outcome guarantee.

decision_clarity.instructions: The submitted proposal clearly names its review audience, decision, horizon, recommended validation choice, alternatives including status quo, and conditions for changing course; it does not pretend Deere has approved execution.

evidence_fit.instructions: The supplied extracted claims and source evidence support the proposal at its stated certainty: exact primary facts have attributable citations and period/units; load-bearing strategic inferences use independent evidence roots; inaccessible content is flagged; no imagined facts or duplicated-source corroboration is presented as proof.

construction_scope.instructions: The proposal is specific to Deere Construction customer jobs and existing dealer/technology capabilities, distinguishes combined Construction & Forestry results, and does not transfer Agriculture economics, allegations or outcomes into Construction as fact.

option_fairness.instructions: The proposal fairly compares at least three genuinely different choices including current product/dealer execution, targeted civil-job productivity/uptime packages and broader platform/autonomy expansion; each has a credible mechanism, benefits, risks and conditions under which it wins.

economics_honesty.instructions: Any submitted economic figures have explicit units, formulas, input provenance, timing and sensitivities. Analyst scenarios are labelled assumptions, not Deere forecasts or observed returns; no invented internal baseline, TAM conversion or ROI guarantee is implied.

falsifiability.instructions: The proposal connects plausible competitor, customer and dealer responses to mechanisms, observable falsifiers and a specific revise/stop decision; it includes important contrary public evidence rather than merely naming competitors.

operating_loop.instructions: The proposal supplies proposed accountable roles, a baseline-establishment phase, defined measures, review cadence, dependencies and stop/continue criteria; internal access and authority are explicit preconditions, not claims of current approval.

uncertainty_integrity.instructions: The proposal visibly separates public facts, survey expectation measures, unverified anecdotes, analyst inferences and proposed actions. Complaint samples are not treated as prevalence; logical-agent simulation is not represented as hundreds of real LLM workers or calibrated prediction.

audience_usability.instructions: The submitted deck evidence lets a senior audience find the recommendation, why it differs, option comparison, economic logic, limitations and next decision without narration; all slide content is populated and no template how-to/sample/placeholder material remains.

visual_quality.instructions: The supplied actual render evidence shows readable action headlines and body text, clean charts/tables/diagrams, sufficient contrast, consistent supplied-template style and no clipped/overlapping/off-canvas content. A claimed render pass without images or measured artifact evidence is insufficient.

rules.reason: decision framing below user quality floor
claim-source fit below user quality floor
construction specificity below user quality floor
option fairness below user quality floor
operating loop below user quality floor
uncertainty discipline below user quality floor
audience usability below user quality floor
actual visual evidence below user quality floor

notes.scope: Local public-research deliverable only, requested 2026-10-02. JEV scores are advisory probabilities of criterion satisfaction; deterministic checks and independent review remain required.
notes.negative_controls: Polished but unsupported claims, anecdote prevalence, duplicated roots, ROI without formula, cosmetic alternatives, competitor name-dropping, ownerless roadmap, unreadable layout, hidden template debris, Agriculture-to-Construction leap must fail.
